title: Give the classifier an orphan verdict for a record whose worktree and branch are both gone
action: The shipped classifier keeps every workspace record whose branch no longer exists: `git merge-base --is-ancestor` cannot exit 0 for a missing branch, and D2a's fail-closed rule correctly reads that as not-provably-merged. Verified live -- all 13 orphan records under .bee/runtime/workspaces/ report kept with that reason, forever. Right for a live worktree, wrong for a pure orphan. Add ONE new verdict branch to classify_worktree, evaluated BEFORE the merge test: when the worktree directory does NOT exist AND the record's branch does NOT exist (check with the existing branch_exists helper in worktree/git.rs), the record is the only artifact left -- there is no directory to remove, no commits to strand, no ignored files to lose -- so it is dead with an orphan reason, and no ancestry test is asked or needed. Prune's teardown for this verdict drops the record, the grant and the holds release, and NEVER touches a directory (there is none). Every other case keeps its current verdict unchanged. THE TWO CONDITIONS ARE A CONJUNCTION AND EACH ONE ALONE MUST STILL KEEP: a missing directory with a live branch keeps (the branch may hold unmerged commits); an existing directory with a missing branch keeps (the tree may hold uncommitted or ignored work). Only both-absent reaches the new branch. Make the reason string say plainly that nothing could be lost, so the prune report reads as an explanation rather than an assertion.

truths: Directory absent AND branch absent yields the orphan verdict with no ancestry probe run
Directory absent but branch present still keeps
Directory present but branch absent still keeps
The orphan teardown removes no directory and deletes no branch
artifacts: One test per row above, beside the existing keep-reason tests
prohibitions: Do not loosen the merge test or any other keep-condition to reach this case
Do not let the orphan branch remove a directory or delete a branch
Do not evaluate the orphan branch when either artifact still exists

trace.outcome: Added the orphan verdict (directory and branch both gone) to classify_worktree, evaluated before the merge test, with a matching registry-only teardown path and four new tests; updated the pruning-dead-worktrees knowledge doc.
